card.name: Climate and emissions news text
card.fires_on: Scattered words inside climate-change and emissions news articles, such as Copenhagen, opening quotation marks, and linking words like than, by, according. It fires on the topic setting more than on one word.

modes.label: Copenhagen and COP talks
modes.description: The word Copenhagen or quote marks around pledge and target phrases in climate-summit text.

modes.label: Linking words in emissions prose
modes.description: Small words such as than, by, be, according in sentences about warming and carbon.
modes.example: has a warming effect in the atmosphere three to four times greater<< than>> prevailing estimates
